Big Data, Analytics, and ML Services

大数据、分析与机器学习服务

In the world of information technology, data is generated at a huge volume. This data can be just the information of all registered users on online food-ordering applications or real-time user actions captured on the application. Data generated at large volume is referred to as big data. If you have a use case to store this data, you can utilize the storage solutions we discussed in Chapter 10 based on your requirements. This chapter focuses on how to process the data at high volume. How can we generate insights out of data already present in storage or live streaming data by running data analytics or ML models on top of it? For example, we might want to determine the most ordered food item based on location or the restaurant with the highest rating in a particular locality.

在信息技术的世界里，数据以巨大的体量被生成。这些数据可以只是在线点餐应用上所有注册用户的信息，也可以是在应用上捕获的实时用户行为。以大体量生成的数据被称为大数据。如果你有用例要存储这些数据，可以根据需求利用我们在第 10 章讨论过的存储解决方案。本章聚焦于如何处理高体量数据。我们如何在存储中已有的数据或实时流数据之上运行数据分析或 ML 模型，从而产生洞见？例如，我们可能想根据位置点单最多的菜品，或某个区域评分最高的餐厅。

The first part of this chapter introduces you to AWS big data, live streaming, and analytics services such as Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR), AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, Amazon QuickSight, and Amazon Redshift. The second section explores how you can run ML workloads on the AWS cloud and the different services supporting that.

本章第一部分向你介绍 AWS 大数据、实时流和分析服务，例如 Amazon Elastic MapReduce（EMR）、AWS Glue、Amazon Athena、Amazon QuickSight 和 Amazon Redshift。第二部分探索如何在 AWS 云上运行 ML 工作负载，以及支持这一点的各项服务。

AWS Big Data and Analytics

Information is vital to making business decisions or serving our customers better, but the volume of data is rapidly growing, ranging from terabytes to petabytes (and more). The variety of data is also increasing—data can be in any form. We require specific tools to store and process big data. Traditional tools can become a bottleneck as we can no longer operate on a single machine for data processing. Another challenge is the velocity at which this data is produced: we require tools to consume the data and produce insights from it in near real time to gain maximum output.

信息对于做出业务决策或更好地服务客户至关重要，但数据量正在快速增长，从 TB 到 PB（甚至更多）。数据的种类也在增加——数据可以是任何形式。我们需要专门的工具来存储和处理大数据。传统工具可能成为瓶颈，因为我们无法再在单机上做数据处理。另一个挑战是数据产生的速度：我们需要工具近实时地消费数据并从中产生洞见，以获得最大产出。

Page 351

In this section, we’ll talk about data processing tools like Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, and Amazon Redshift, as well as a business intelligence service, Amazon QuickSight.

在本节中，我们将讨论 Amazon EMR、AWS Glue、Amazon Athena 和 Amazon Redshift 等数据处理工具，以及一项商业智能服务 Amazon QuickSight。

Amazon Elastic MapReduce

In Chapter 8, we introduced you to big data architecture, multiple concepts underlying it, and open source tools for working with it, such as Hadoop, MapReduce, Spark, Presto, and HDFS. AWS offers managed services that are built directly on top of these open source software applications to get started easily with zero (or minimum) operational overhead. Hadoop open source software is popular for big data processing; Amazon EMR is a managed service for executing data processing frameworks and tools such as MapReduce, Apache Spark, Apache Hive, Apache HBase, and Presto.

在第 8 章，我们向你介绍了大数据架构、其背后的多个概念，以及处理它的开源工具，例如 Hadoop、MapReduce、Spark、Presto 和 HDFS。AWS 提供直接构建在这些开源软件之上的托管服务，让你零（或最小）运维开销即可轻松上手。Hadoop 开源软件因大数据处理而流行；Amazon EMR 是一项托管服务，用于执行数据处理框架和工具，例如 MapReduce、Apache Spark、Apache Hive、Apache HBase 和 Presto。

Setting up and managing large clusters require time and expertise, but EMR makes it easy by offering a managed service where you can launch clusters in minutes and run large data-processing workloads. Open source Hadoop clusters default to HDFS for data storage. You can also explore using different tools available in the community to extend the storage to Amazon S3.

搭建和管理大型集群需要时间和专业知识，但 EMR 通过提供托管服务让这一切变简单：你可以在几分钟内启动集群并运行大型数据处理工作负载。开源 Hadoop 集群默认使用 HDFS 存储数据。你也可以探索使用社区中可用的不同工具，把存储扩展到 Amazon S3。

HDFS is tied to the local disks, which disappear once the cluster terminates. Since our use case is processing big data, our storage needs will grow over time, and since HDFS is attached to compute instances, the number of instances will also increase. There is a possibility that our use case has high storage requirements but the compute requirement is relatively less, so we’re paying for the compute but not using it at full capacity. This is where the EMR File System (EMRFS) can be a better solution.

HDFS 绑定在本地磁盘上，集群一旦终止这些磁盘就消失。由于我们的用例是处理大数据，存储需求会随时间增长，而 HDFS 附着在计算实例上，实例数量也会增加。有可能我们的用例存储需求高、但计算需求相对较少，于是我们为计算付费却没有充分利用。这正是 EMR 文件系统（EMRFS）可以成为更好解决方案的地方。

EMRFS

EMRFS uses Amazon S3 as a filesystem for data processing instead of a local HDFS, so essentially, it’s a connector that links EMR clusters to S3. EMRFS ensures streaming of data directly to S3 and uses HDFS as intermediate storage.

EMRFS 使用 Amazon S3 作为数据处理的文件系统，而不是本地 HDFS，因此本质上它是一个把 EMR 集群链接到 S3 的 connector。EMRFS 确保数据直接流式写入 S3，并使用 HDFS 作为中间存储。

Before we dive into EMRFS, understand that it is not a solution to every problem, and you should not see it as a replacement for HDFS. HDFS can still be a better option for jobs with iterative reads on the same dataset or I/O-intensive workloads (meaning workloads that require frequent disk access and retrieval of data over the network since these scenarios could prove to be latency-intensive operations).

在深入 EMRFS 之前，请理解它并非万能解药，你不应把它视为 HDFS 的替代品。对于对同一数据集做迭代读取的作业、或 I/O 密集型工作负载（即需要频繁磁盘访问、并通过网络检索数据的工作负载，因为这些场景可能被证明是延迟密集型操作），HDFS 仍可能是更好的选择。

You can use a combination of S3 and HDFS to address the temporary data storage limitation of HDFS (data is lost on cluster termination) by leveraging tools such as S3DistCP to copy data from S3 to HDFS or from HDFS to S3.

你可以结合使用 S3 和 HDFS，利用 S3DistCP 等工具把数据从 S3 复制到 HDFS 或从 HDFS 复制到 S3，从而解决 HDFS 临时数据存储的限制（集群终止时数据丢失）。

Let’s look into some of the benefits that EMRFS offers over traditional HDFS:

下面我们看看 EMRFS 相比传统 HDFS 提供的一些好处：

Page 352
  • In scenarios when you require the same data to be accessed by multiple clusters, you need to copy data from one cluster to another since HDFS is associated with a single cluster and not shared among all clusters. You can save this cost by using EMRFS as a storage option. EMRFS allows multiple clusters to access the data from the same place, decoupling compute and storage completely, and offers flexibility to scale them independently.
    在需要多个集群访问同一份数据的场景中，由于 HDFS 与单个集群关联、不在所有集群间共享，你需要把数据从一个集群复制到另一个。使用 EMRFS 作为存储选项可以省下这笔成本。EMRFS 允许多个集群从同一位置访问数据，把计算和存储完全解耦，并提供独立扩缩的灵活性。
  • You might not always require your EMR cluster to be running. So you can terminate the cluster, and storage is maintained in S3, saving compute costs.
    你未必总是需要 EMR 集群一直运行。因此你可以终止集群，而存储保留在 S3 中，从而节省计算成本。
  • To ensure data availability, HDFS replicates the data at multiple nodes per the replication factor. For example, with a replication factor of three, you’ll be paying three times the storage cost. EMRFS is backed by S3, so you don’t have to worry about data durability as it is already handled by S3.
    为确保数据可用性，HDFS 按副本因子在多个节点上复制数据。例如副本因子为 3 时，你要付 3 倍的存储成本。EMRFS 由 S3 支撑，因此你无需担心数据持久性，因为它已由 S3 处理。

These data points provide a clear picture of why EMRFS is a useful utility to consider for storing data. You can get the most out of any tool if you follow certain best practices associated with it. Here are some tips for using EMRFS:

这些数据点清楚地说明了为什么 EMRFS 是一个值得考虑的数据存储实用工具。遵循与工具相关的某些最佳实践，你才能把任何工具的价值发挥到最大。下面是使用 EMRFS 的一些技巧：

  • The data should be partitioned so that the EMR cluster fetches only the data required for processing. This ensures faster data retrieval along with reduced costs.
    数据应当分区，使 EMR 集群只取处理所需的数据。这既加快数据检索，又降低成本。
  • The file size should be optimized such that you don’t have too many or too few files. As you start using EMRFS, try to avoid files with a size of less than 128 MB because that will ensure fewer calls to S3 along with HDFS requests.
    文件大小应优化到文件数既不太多也不太少。刚开始使用 EMRFS 时，尽量避免小于 128 MB 的文件，因为这样可以减少对 S3 的调用以及 HDFS 请求。
  • We also recommend considering data compression, ensuring less usage of storage space on S3. This helps reduce costs on two fronts: storage costs and network costs for data retrieval.
    我们还建议考虑数据压缩，以减少 S3 上存储空间的使用。这在两方面帮助降低成本：存储成本和数据检索的网络成本。
  • The data-access patterns can vary based on the use case. You might be interested in only a subset of columns across the columns or a subset of rows across the rows. Apache Parquet and Apache ORC are columnar file formats that give increased read performance to meet the first use case, and Apache Avro, a row-optimized file format, is helpful for the latter use case.
    数据访问模式因用例而异。你可能只对列中的一个子集感兴趣，或只对行中的一个子集感兴趣。Apache Parquet 和 Apache ORC 是列式文件格式，能为第一个用例提供更高的读性能；Apache Avro 是行优化的文件格式，对后一个用例有帮助。

Now that you have a good grasp of the concept of EMRFS as a storage option, let’s explore other EMR features and specifications.

既然你已经很好地理解了 EMRFS 作为存储选项的概念，下面我们探索 EMR 的其他特性和规格。

EMR cluster considerations

The data-processing jobs run on a set of servers, and instance types can be chosen based on workload requirements. As a compute option, you can choose to run an EMR cluster on EC2 instances or EKS, or you can go completely serverless.

数据处理作业运行在一组服务器上，实例类型可以根据工作负载需求选择。作为计算选项，你可以选择在 EC2 实例或 EKS 上运行 EMR 集群，也可以完全 serverless。

The EMR cluster architecture can have three types of nodes, shown in Figure 13-1:

EMR 集群架构可以有三种类型的节点，如图 13-1 所示：

Page 353

Primary node. The primary node is the primary node in the EMR cluster. The primary node uses the YARN resource manager service for application resource management and runs the HDFS NameNode service to track the status of jobs submitted on the cluster along with health monitoring of instance groups.

Primary 节点。primary 节点是 EMR 集群中的主节点。primary 节点使用 YARN resource manager 服务做应用资源管理，并运行 HDFS NameNode 服务来跟踪集群上提交作业的状态，以及对实例组做健康监控。

Core node. The core nodes run the data daemon for HDFS data storage and the task tracker daemon to perform computation tasks on data. The EMR cluster can have a maximum of one core instance group or instance fleet.

Core 节点。core 节点运行用于 HDFS 数据存储的 data 守护进程和用于对数据执行计算任务的 task tracker 守护进程。EMR 集群最多可以有一个 core 实例组或实例队列（instance fleet）。

Task node. Task nodes don’t provide data storage—they should be used as extra computation power for the EMR cluster. EMR by default ensures that the application primary of any job runs on the core node to make sure the job doesn’t terminate if any of the task nodes are terminated (as in the case of EC2 spot instances). You can configure up to 48 task instance groups depending on the job requirements.

Task 节点。task 节点不提供数据存储——它们应用作 EMR 集群的额外计算力。EMR 默认确保任何作业的 application primary 运行在 core 节点上，以保证即使某个 task 节点被终止（如 EC2 spot 实例的情况）作业也不会终止。你可以根据作业需求配置最多 48 个 task 实例组。

The EMR cluster allows you to choose from the available applications, and it will auto-install all the software without any effort from your end. There may also be a requirement to install custom software or modify a configuration for nodes on EMR nodes. To support this, you can use EMR bootstrap actions, which execute the action after the cluster instances are up.

EMR 集群允许你从可用应用中选择，它会自动安装所有软件，无需你费力。也可能需要在 EMR 节点上安装自定义软件或修改节点配置。为支持这一点，你可以使用 EMR bootstrap action，它在集群实例启动后执行相应动作。

Depending on the requirements, the EMR cluster can consist of a large number of nodes, which will definitely add to the resource cost incurred from AWS. You can introduce some cost-saving mechanisms:

根据需求，EMR 集群可能包含大量节点，这肯定会增加 AWS 上的资源成本。你可以引入一些节省成本的机制：

  • EMR provides a configuration to automatically terminate clusters. This ensures the cluster is auto-terminated once the submitted jobs are completed.
    EMR 提供一个自动终止集群的配置。这确保所提交作业完成后集群自动终止。
  • You may have requirements for long-running clusters. If you’re sure of the capacity requirements, you can explore reserved instances and AWS saving plans.
    你可能有长期运行集群的需求。如果对容量需求有把握，可以考虑预留实例和 AWS savings plan。
Page 354
  • If the EMR workloads are noncritical, you can use EC2 spot instances (discussed in Chapter 11). The spot instances are offered at up to a 90% discount compared to the on-demand instances and can substantially reduce costs. You can also set up clusters with a mix of spot and on-demand instances to ensure the cluster is always up and running while keeping cluster pricing in mind.
    如果 EMR 工作负载是非关键的，你可以使用 EC2 spot 实例（第 11 章讨论过）。spot 实例相比 on-demand 实例最高可享 90% 折扣，能大幅降低成本。你也可以用 spot 和 on-demand 实例混合搭建集群，以在兼顾集群价格的同时确保集群始终运行。
  • For the variable workloads on long-running clusters, you can use automatic scaling policies on instance groups to add or remove instances.
    对于长期运行集群上的可变工作负载，你可以在实例组上使用自动扩缩策略来增加或移除实例。

Before we close our discussion on EMR, let’s ponder some considerations for ensuring high reliability of workloads running on EMR clusters:

在结束对 EMR 的讨论之前，让我们思考一些确保运行在 EMR 集群上工作负载高可靠性的注意事项：

  • The instances in clusters should be spread across AZs to avoid any AZ downtimes. By default, the Hive metastore is stored on the primary node’s filesystem. Store the metastore outside the EMR cluster, such as inside a multi-AZ RDS cluster or Amazon Aurora, to avoid data loss upon cluster termination.
    集群中的实例应跨 AZ 分布，以避免任何 AZ 宕机。默认情况下，Hive metastore 存储在 primary 节点的文件系统上。请把 metastore 存储在 EMR 集群之外，例如多 AZ RDS 集群或 Amazon Aurora 中，以避免集群终止时数据丢失。
  • We recommend using EMR with multiple primary nodes instead of single-primary node. The primary node is a single point of failure, and if it goes down, the entire cluster goes down. Multiple primary node setup provides a safety net.
    我们推荐使用多 primary 节点的 EMR，而非单 primary 节点。primary 节点是单点故障，如果它宕机，整个集群都宕机。多 primary 节点设置提供了一张安全网。
  • Critical data should be kept in S3 instead of a local HDFS to avoid any data dependency issues.
    关键数据应保存在 S3 中而非本地 HDFS，以避免任何数据依赖问题。
  • We recommend EC2 spot instances only for task nodes and not for core nodes. As HDFS is managed by core nodes for data storage, termination of these nodes might lead to data loss.
    我们推荐仅对 task 节点使用 EC2 spot 实例，而不要对 core 节点使用。由于 HDFS 由 core 节点管理数据存储，终止这些节点可能导致数据丢失。

To address the requirement of spawning EMR clusters at regular intervals, you can leverage Amazon EventBridge and automate the workflow via AWS Step Functions (or Apache Airflow) like so: create an EMR cluster with a specific configuration, submit jobs to the cluster, and once the jobs are complete, terminate the cluster.

为满足定期生成 EMR 集群的需求，你可以利用 Amazon EventBridge，并通过 AWS Step Functions（或 Apache Airflow）把工作流自动化，像这样：创建一个特定配置的 EMR 集群、向集群提交作业、作业完成后终止集群。

In some scenarios, we just care about executing the ETL jobs without worrying about instance or storage management. AWS Glue is a completely serverless data integration application for performing analytical tasks on big data.

在某些场景中，我们只关心执行 ETL 作业，而无需操心实例或存储管理。AWS Glue 是一个完全 serverless 的数据集成应用，用于对大数据执行分析任务。

AWS Glue

AWS Glue is a data integration service that helps make sense of data with different features. Before digging into these features, let’s quickly understand some of the terminology associated with Glue:

AWS Glue 是一项数据集成服务，通过不同特性帮助你理解数据。在深入这些特性之前，我们先快速理解与 Glue 相关的一些术语：

Classifier. A classifier validates whether it can handle the data available in the specific format, and if it can, then it is classified into a StructType object. You can use the

Classifier（分类器）。classifier 验证它是否能处理特定格式的数据，如果可以，就把数据归类为一个 StructType 对象。你可以使用

Page 355

classifiers offered by Glue or define a custom classifier as needed, such as when a data file is not in a format supported by Glue.

Glue 提供的 classifier，或在需要时（例如数据文件不是 Glue 支持的格式）自定义 classifier。

Metadata. The metadata is the inferred schema by the classifier from the available data in any of the data stores.

元数据（Metadata）。元数据是 classifier 从任一数据存储中的可用数据推断出的 schema。

Database. The database is the place where you keep metadata tables. A single table can be associated to a single database only, and in case the database is not specified, Glue uses the default database.

数据库（Database）。database 是你存放元数据表的地方。单个表只能关联到一个 database；如果未指定 database，Glue 使用默认 database。

Data catalog. The data catalog maintains databases, which then consist of one or more metadata tables. These tables can be useful as source and target.

数据目录（Data catalog）。数据目录维护 database，而 database 由一个或多个元数据表组成。这些表可以用作 source 和 target。

Data crawler. The data crawler crawls the data from data sources like Amazon S3, figures out the schema via the classifier, and then creates the required tables or partitions in the Glue data catalog. For use cases where the data schema frequently changes, you can run the crawler on a schedule, and it automatically figures out modifications since the last run and creates new tables or partitions per the requirements.

数据 crawler。数据 crawler 从 Amazon S3 等数据源爬取数据，通过 classifier 弄清 schema，然后在 Glue 数据目录中创建所需的表或分区。对于数据 schema 频繁变化的用例，你可以按计划运行 crawler，它会自动弄清自上次运行以来的修改，并按需创建新表或分区。

Table partitioning. Partitioning is a way to improve query performance on data. Let’s understand it with the help of an example, shown in Figure 13-2. Your application processes sales data and is stored in S3, divided into folders with the parent folder as the year and child folders as months and days. It can have further subfolders, such as hours or minutes, depending on the type and amount of data. If the data is partitioned in such a fashion, it becomes very easy to query for it. Extracting data for February 2022 means going to the folder for Year 2022 and then to the subfolder Month 02, making the query much faster. There can be multiple partition keys for a table, and you can create a partition index, a subset of partitions, to avoid loading all the partitions.

表分区（Table partitioning）。分区是一种提升数据查询性能的方式。我们借助图 13-2 的例子来理解。你的应用处理销售数据并存储在 S3 中，划分为文件夹，父文件夹为年，子文件夹为月和日。根据数据类型和数量，它还可以有更深的子文件夹，例如小时或分钟。如果数据以这种方式分区，查询就变得非常容易。提取 2022 年 2 月的数据意味着进入 Year 2022 文件夹、再进入 Month 02 子文件夹，从而让查询快得多。一个表可以有多个分区键，你可以创建分区 index（partition 的一个子集）以避免加载所有分区。

Page 356

Data engine. The data engine runs data-processing jobs on top of the data. Glue supports three data engines at the time of writing: AWS Glue for Apache Spark, AWS Glue for Ray, and AWS Glue for Python Shell. You can choose one based on your workload requirements:

数据引擎（Data engine）。数据引擎在数据之上运行数据处理作业。在撰写本书时，Glue 支持三种数据引擎：AWS Glue for Apache Spark、AWS Glue for Ray 和 AWS Glue for Python Shell。你可以根据工作负载需求选择其一：

  • With Glue for Apache Spark, you can write ETL code in Python and Scala languages, and the code executes in a distributed environment. The Spark environment on Glue can be assumed as a serverless EMR cluster being operated by AWS. The Spark engine is supported for both batch processing and live streaming data. Glue also addresses a very general problem of disk spilling due to data shuffling (data redistribution within the cluster) by providing a Cloud Shuffle plug-in. This plug-in allows you to use S3 or any other object storage in data-spilling situations. The plug-in is available as open source software, so it can be used in custom Spark jobs as well.
    使用 Glue for Apache Spark，你可以用 Python 和 Scala 语言编写 ETL 代码，代码在分布式环境中执行。Glue 上的 Spark 环境可以理解为由 AWS 运营的 serverless EMR 集群。Spark 引擎同时支持批处理和实时流数据。Glue 还通过提供 Cloud Shuffle 插件解决了一个非常普遍的问题：因数据 shuffle（集群内的数据重分布）导致的磁盘溢写。这个插件让你在数据溢写时可以使用 S3 或任何其他对象存储。该插件以开源软件形式提供，因此也可用于自定义 Spark 作业。
  • With Glue for Python, a single-node Python engine runs workloads written in Python. It offers default integration with open source libraries like numpy or pandas, and you can add custom libraries as well. The one problem that customers might face is workload scaling as data grows, which can be resolved by using Glue for Ray.
    使用 Glue for Python，一个单节点 Python 引擎运行用 Python 编写的工作负载。它默认集成 numpy 或 pandas 等开源库，你也可以添加自定义库。客户可能面临的一个问题是：随着数据增长工作负载如何扩缩，这可以通过使用 Glue for Ray 解决。
Page 357
  • Glue for Ray allows you to execute Python code in a distributed environment setup and is scalable to hundreds of nodes. This processing engine is based on the open source compute framework Ray, which is extensively used to run Python workloads at large scale, such as deep learning models.
    Glue for Ray 允许你在分布式环境中执行 Python 代码，并可扩缩到数百个节点。这个处理引擎基于开源计算框架 Ray，后者被广泛用于大规模运行 Python 工作负载，例如深度学习模型。

Data processing units (DPUs). Glue allows customers to configure types of workers to run the data processing jobs, referred to as DPUs. You can analyze your workload requirements to find the best configuration of DPUs.

数据处理单元（DPU）。Glue 允许客户配置 worker 的类型来运行数据处理作业，这些 worker 称为 DPU。你可以分析工作负载需求，找到最佳的 DPU 配置。

Glue and EMR vary on their base functionality, and we as customers should clearly lay out our requirements to choose one for our workloads. Much like EMR and Glue, Amazon Athena is an AWS service that is helpful for querying and analyzing data stored in Amazon S3. You can compare Athena with Presto running on an EMR cluster, which provides similar functionality. The main advantage of such solutions is that data analysis can be performed on raw data without any transformation at the customer’s end.

与 EMR 和 Glue 类似，Amazon Athena 是一项有助于查询和分析存储在 Amazon S3 中数据的 AWS 服务。你可以把 Athena 与运行在 EMR 集群上的 Presto 比较，后者提供类似功能。这类方案的主要优势是：可以直接对原始数据做数据分析，而无需客户做任何转换。

Amazon Athena

Amazon Athena is a fully managed, serverless, big data analysis tool that offers SQL query support on top of data stored in S3. The data analysis doesn’t require any transfer of data to other data storage; the data can be directly read from S3 objects and can be queried.

Amazon Athena 是一项全托管、serverless 的大数据分析工具，在 S3 中存储的数据之上提供 SQL 查询支持。数据分析不需要把数据传输到其他数据存储；可以直接从 S3 对象读取数据并进行查询。

Athena requires that we as customers define the databases and tables with schema. You can do this task manually or leverage the Glue data crawler and Apache Hive metastore to perform this task for you. Once the database and tables are defined, you can query this data with simple SQL. As you execute the SQL query, Athena internally submits a job that operates in asynchronous fashion, and the response to the query is saved to S3. Additionally, you can integrate Athena with various BI tools for interactive analysis, such as Amazon QuickSight, which we’ll discuss in the next section.

Athena 要求我们作为客户定义带 schema 的 database 和表。你可以手动完成这项任务，也可以利用 Glue 数据 crawler 和 Apache Hive metastore 替你完成。一旦 database 和表定义好，你就可以用简单 SQL 查询这些数据。当你执行 SQL 查询时，Athena 在内部提交一个以异步方式运行的作业，查询响应被保存到 S3。此外，你可以把 Athena 与各种 BI 工具集成以做交互式分析，例如 Amazon QuickSight，我们将在下一节讨论。

Like many other services, Athena’s main advantage is that you don’t have to worry about infrastructure management. Let’s discuss a few other features and considerations for using this service for your data analytics use cases:

与许多其他服务一样，Athena 的主要优势是你无需操心基础设施管理。下面我们讨论把这项服务用于数据分析用例时的其他一些特性和注意事项：

Page 360

Federated query. We mentioned that Athena is used to query on data stored in S3, but what about data present in other AWS data stores, such as Amazon DynamoDB or on-premises data sources? For these kinds of use cases, Athena offers a feature called federated query. This feature allows you to run SQL queries on a variety of data stores, be they on the AWS cloud or on-premises. Athena achieves this via a Lambda-based data source connector; the connector essentially helps establish a connection and retrieve data. In addition, Athena can have multiple Lambda invocations in parallel to fasten data processing tasks. It is also possible that data won’t fit into Lambda memory; to handle this, the data is spilled to S3, avoiding any data loss.

联合查询（Federated query）。我们提到 Athena 用于查询 S3 中存储的数据，但其他 AWS 数据存储（例如 Amazon DynamoDB）或本地数据源中的数据呢？对于这类用例，Athena 提供了一个称为联合查询的特性。该特性允许你对各种数据存储运行 SQL 查询，无论它们在 AWS 云上还是在本地。Athena 通过基于 Lambda 的数据源 connector 实现这一点；该 connector 本质上帮助建立连接并检索数据。此外，Athena 可以并行发起多次 Lambda 调用来加快数据处理任务。数据也可能装不进 Lambda 内存；为处理这一点，数据被溢写到 S3，避免任何数据丢失。

User-defined functions (UDFs). UDFs are another feature of Athena supported via the federated query SDK. They allow you to write custom Java code on Lambda and invoke directly from SQL queries to perform any preprocessing or postprocessing tasks on data. Consider a scenario of sensitive data handling: to avoid storing sensitive information to S3 as part of the Athena query response, it is masked via logic executed in UDFs.

用户定义函数（UDF）。UDF 是 Athena 通过联合查询 SDK 支持的另一项特性。它们允许你在 Lambda 上编写自定义 Java 代码，并直接从 SQL 查询中调用，以对数据执行任何预处理或后处理任务。考虑敏感数据处理的场景：为避免把敏感信息作为 Athena 查询响应的一部分存储到 S3，可通过在 UDF 中执行的逻辑将其遮蔽。

ML models. Athena allows you to use deployed ML models on Amazon SageMaker. You can directly invoke these models in a SQL query for required data analysis. One example could be detecting negative reviews for our online food-ordering platform.

ML 模型。Athena 允许你使用部署在 Amazon SageMaker 上的 ML 模型。你可以在 SQL 查询中直接调用这些模型来做所需的数据分析。一个例子是为我们的在线点餐平台检测负面评论。

To help with regular scheduling of workflows or invocation based on certain events, we can leverage Amazon EventBridge. For use cases of workflow orchestration and integration with other services, we can utilize AWS Step Functions.

为帮助定期调度工作流或基于某些事件触发调用，我们可以利用 Amazon EventBridge。对于工作流编排以及与其他服务集成的用例，我们可以利用 AWS Step Functions。

The limitation of using Amazon Athena instead of self-managed Amazon EMR clusters or Amazon Redshift (which we’ll discuss shortly) could be the time it takes to execute queries on large datasets, so it might not be the best solution for latency-sensitive operations.

使用 Amazon Athena 而非自管理 Amazon EMR 集群或 Amazon Redshift（我们稍后讨论）的局限可能是在大型数据集上执行查询所需的时间，因此它可能不是延迟敏感型操作的最佳方案。

We mentioned that QuickSight is helpful for drawing insights, and it can do that for any data source. One such data source is Amazon Redshift.

我们提到 QuickSight 有助于提炼洞见，并且它可以对任何数据源做到这一点。其中一个数据源就是 Amazon Redshift。

Amazon Redshift

In simple terms, Amazon Redshift is a data warehousing tool that can act as a data store for data from multiple sources and that lets you run SQL queries at a single place for data analytics. Redshift is an AWS-managed service and can scale to petabytes of data with an elastic scaling option. There is also a serverless option, which helps you avoid any burden of resource provisioning and workload management.

简而言之，Amazon Redshift 是一个数据仓库工具，可以作为来自多个数据源的数据的数据存储，并让你在单一地点运行 SQL 查询做数据分析。Redshift 是 AWS 托管服务，可以借助弹性扩缩选项扩展到 PB 级数据。它还有一个 serverless 选项，帮你避免资源预置和工作负载管理的负担。

We’ll begin by discussing the architecture of Redshift and then move on to key features offered by this service. Redshift is columnar, PostgreSQL-based storage based on a leader-follower cluster architecture, where the leader acts as a query coordinator that parses and compiles the query and then forwards the query to follower (compute) nodes, which work in parallel to gather results. This architecture is shown in Figure 13-4. There can be from 2 to 128 nodes in a Redshift cluster, and in the case of the serverless option, the entire architecture is abstracted out from customers. The

我们先讨论 Redshift 的架构，再转向该服务提供的关键特性。Redshift 是列式、基于 PostgreSQL 的存储，基于 leader-follower 集群架构：leader 充当查询协调器，解析并编译查询，然后把查询转发给 follower（计算）节点，这些节点并行工作以收集结果。该架构如图 13-4 所示。一个 Redshift 集群可以有 2 到 128 个节点；对于 serverless 选项，整个架构对客户是抽象掉的。

Page 362

query can be invoked from SQL clients via a Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) or Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) connection, or it can use the Data API. The Data API offers query execution in both synchronous and asynchronous fashion and can query for results within 24 hours with a query ID.

查询可以从 SQL 客户端通过 Java Database Connectivity（JDBC）或 Open Database Connectivity（ODBC）连接发起，也可以使用 Data API。Data API 同时提供同步和异步方式的查询执行，并可凭一个查询 ID 在 24 小时内查询结果。

With the Redshift architecture, the compute nodes are partitioned into slices, and each slice has its own allocated disk and memory to perform parallel processing. The data is stored in immutable blocks. A block consists of column data spanning multiple rows, and a full block can contain millions of values with a size of 1 MB. To improve query performance over the data blocks, Redshift maintains in-memory metadata information called zone maps. It stores the minimum and maximum values for a block and effectively prunes the data blocks that don’t contain data for a specific query. Zone maps can be optimized using a sort key, which defines how data is sorted on the physical disk. The sort key works well except in a very few scenarios: when there is only one block per column per slice; when the values within blocks have the same prefix (for strings longer than 8 bytes—Redshift takes the first 8 bytes as a prefix, so sorting won’t matter if it’s the same); and when the column contains a single distinct value (sorting won’t matter since minimum and maximum values are consistent).

在 Redshift 架构中，计算节点被划分为多个 slice，每个 slice 有自己分配的磁盘和内存以执行并行处理。数据存储在不可变的 block 中。一个 block 由跨多行的列数据组成，一个完整 block 可包含数百万个值，大小为 1 MB。为提升对数据 block 的查询性能，Redshift 维护一种称为 zone map 的内存元数据信息。它存储一个 block 的最小值和最大值，并有效裁剪掉不包含特定查询数据的 block。zone map 可以用 sort key 优化，sort key 定义数据在物理磁盘上如何排序。sort key 效果很好，但在极少数场景下除外：每个 slice 每列只有一个 block 时；block 内的值具有相同前缀时（对于超过 8 字节的字符串——Redshift 取前 8 字节作为前缀，如果相同则排序无意义）；以及列只含单个不同值时（排序无意义，因为最小值和最大值一致）。

Page 363

To optimize query performance, you can optionally choose to provide a distribution style for data. This ensures that data is evenly distributed across the cluster and that you can make the best out of parallel processing. Redshift supports four distribution styles:

为优化查询性能，你可以选择性地为数据提供一种分布方式。这确保数据在集群上均匀分布，从而充分利用并行处理。Redshift 支持四种分布方式：

AUTO option (default). Redshift chooses the distribution style based on the size of the table data and internally switches among the different distribution styles based on the size.

AUTO 选项（默认）。Redshift 根据表数据的大小选择分布方式，并在内部根据大小在不同分布方式之间切换。

EVEN option. Data is distributed across the compute node slices in round-robin fashion by the leader node. This is a recommended option when there are no join operations on the table.

EVEN 选项。数据由 leader 节点以轮询（round-robin）方式分布到各计算节点 slice 上。当表上没有 join 操作时，推荐使用这个选项。

KEY option. The leader node checks the column value and places it on the compute node slice matching its value.

KEY 选项。leader 节点检查列值，并把它放到与该值匹配的计算节点 slice 上。

ALL option. The entire table data is available on each node. This is only recommended if there are very few insert or update operations on the table.

ALL 选项。整个表的数据在每个节点上都可用。仅当表上插入或更新操作很少时才推荐使用。

Redshift offers Redshift Spectrum, which can use S3 as storage; the compute nodes are only responsible for gathering the results. This helps customers directly query the data from S3 without loading it to Redshift clusters. One key consideration here is repeated reads against S3 since the storage doesn’t adhere to transactional guarantees.

Redshift 提供 Redshift Spectrum，它可以使用 S3 作为存储；计算节点只负责收集结果。这帮助客户直接查询 S3 中的数据，而无需把它加载到 Redshift 集群。这里一个关键注意点是对 S3 的重复读取，因为该存储不遵守事务保证。

Redshift also offers Redshift Managed Storage (RMS), which allows customers to scale compute and storage independently. It uses S3 as persistent storage and offers high speed, SSD-backed, Tier 1 cache support. RMS allows scaling up to 128 TB per instance and up to 16 PB per cluster storage capacity. For scaling further, you can always use S3 as storage.

Redshift 还提供 Redshift Managed Storage（RMS），允许客户独立扩缩计算和存储。它使用 S3 作为持久存储，并提供高速、SSD 支撑的 Tier 1 缓存支持。RMS 允许每个实例扩缩到 128 TB、每个集群存储容量扩缩到 16 PB。要进一步扩缩，你总可以使用 S3 作为存储。

You can choose from different instance types available for your Redshift cluster. The feature is supported by the new Redshift instance type RA3. The other instance types are DC2 (dense compute) with SSD as storage and DS2 (dense storage) with magnetic disks as storage. The DS2 instance types are legacy, and we don’t recommend using them for your workloads.

你可以为 Redshift 集群从可用的不同实例类型中选择。该特性由新的 Redshift 实例类型 RA3 支持。其他实例类型有以 SSD 为存储的 DC2（dense compute）和以磁盘为存储的 DS2（dense storage）。DS2 实例类型是遗留的，我们不推荐把它们用于你的工作负载。

Redshift Spectrum is similar to Athena, where you query on top of the data that sits in S3. The one big difference is you can configure compute, enabling the queries to be much faster. There are additional feature sets for both these services that you should evaluate before choosing one for your workloads:

Redshift Spectrum 类似于 Athena，你在位于 S3 中的数据之上查询。一个大的不同是你可以配置计算，从而让查询快得多。在为工作负载选择其中之一之前，你应评估这两项服务各自的附加特性集：

Materialized views. Redshift allows you to create materialized views from one or more tables to make the queries faster. The materialized views contain precompute result sets

物化视图（Materialized views）。Redshift 允许你从一个或多个表创建物化视图以加快查询。物化视图包含预计算的结果集，

Page 364

based on table joins with all or a subset of columns, aggregations, and filters. You can also create materialized views on top of already created materialized views, similar to base tables.

这些结果集基于表 join（取所有列或列子集）、聚合和过滤。你还可以在已创建的物化视图之上再创建物化视图，类似于基表。

Workload management tools. Redshift offers workload management (WLM) tools to separate different query workloads and assign priority so that important queries are executed and less important queries can be throttled or aborted.

工作负载管理工具。Redshift 提供工作负载管理（WLM）工具，以分离不同查询工作负载并分配优先级，从而让重要查询被执行、较不重要的查询可以被限流或中止。

Data copying. You can use the COPY command to load data to Redshift from Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon EMR, or any remote host accessible via SSH. Support is also available for autocopy, which automatically ingests data from Amazon S3 to Redshift clusters.

数据复制（Data copying）。你可以使用 COPY 命令把数据从 Amazon S3、Amazon DynamoDB、Amazon EMR 或任何可通过 SSH 访问的远程主机加载到 Redshift。它还支持自动复制（autocopy），自动把数据从 Amazon S3 摄入 Redshift 集群。

Data ingestion. You can integrate Redshift with Amazon MSK or Amazon KDS for ingesting live streaming data and use Informatica Data Loader for Amazon Redshift to access data from on-premises or third-party applications.

数据摄入（Data ingestion）。你可以把 Redshift 与 Amazon MSK 或 Amazon KDS 集成以摄入实时流数据，并使用 Informatica Data Loader for Amazon Redshift 从本地或第三方应用访问数据。

Federated query. You can use Redshift’s federated query feature to access live data from external data stores, such as RDS PostgreSQL and MySQL and Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL, without loading it to Redshift clusters.

联合查询（Federated query）。你可以使用 Redshift 的联合查询特性访问来自外部数据存储的实时数据，例如 RDS PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 以及 Aurora PostgreSQL 和 MySQL，而无需把数据加载到 Redshift 集群。

Data sharing. Redshift allows data sharing across the clusters. This helps isolate the read workloads without copying data on multiple clusters.

数据共享（Data sharing）。Redshift 允许跨集群数据共享。这有助于隔离读工作负载，而无需在多个集群上复制数据。

Redshift provides direct integration with Amazon Aurora so as to avoid any pipeline set up by customers, and the data is directly available in Redshift once it is pushed to Aurora within seconds.

Redshift 提供与 Amazon Aurora 的直接集成，以避免客户搭建任何管道，数据一旦在数秒内推入 Aurora，就可在 Redshift 中直接访问。

Amazon Redshift Advisor recommends cluster optimizations around query performance and cost savings, such as query-tuning recommendations, deletion of unused clusters, and table data compression.

Amazon Redshift Advisor 围绕查询性能和成本节省推荐集群优化，例如查询调优建议、删除未使用集群和表数据压缩。

Redshift is a great tool for data warehousing and analytics use cases scaling to petabytes of data. In the next section, we’ll look into different ML services offered by AWS and how they can fit into various use cases.

Redshift 是用于扩展到 PB 级数据的数据仓库和分析用例的好工具。下一节我们将考察 AWS 提供的不同 ML 服务，以及它们如何适配各种用例。

Machine Learning on AWS

To support ML and AI use cases, AWS offers a range of services from building and running your own ML models to leveraging fully customized applications for specific purposes. For example, Amazon Polly converts text to speech, Amazon Comprehend

为支持 ML 和 AI 用例，AWS 提供一系列服务，从构建和运行你自己的 ML 模型，到为特定目的利用完全定制的应用。例如，Amazon Polly 把文本转换为语音，Amazon Comprehend

Page 365

helps you figure out insights and relationships in unstructured data, and Amazon CodeGuru offers intelligent recommendations to improve code quality. Visit the AWS product pages for the latest updates on their capabilities in the field of AI and ML.

帮助你弄清非结构化数据中的洞见和关系，Amazon CodeGuru 提供智能建议以提升代码质量。请访问 AWS 产品页面，了解它们在 AI 和 ML 领域能力的最新更新。

The services can be divided into three broad categories: application services, platform services, and frameworks and hardware solutions. Application services are customized solutions for solving a specific use case. Amazon SageMaker is a platform service that enables you to create your own services by training and deploying ML models. AWS offers different frameworks, such as PyTorch, Keras, and TensorFlow, and special hardware with customized CPU and GPU to run ML workloads. We’ll start our discussion with Amazon SageMaker and then briefly touch on other offerings.

这些服务可分为三大类：应用服务、平台服务，以及框架和硬件方案。应用服务是为解决特定用例而定制的方案。Amazon SageMaker 是一项平台服务，让你通过训练和部署 ML 模型来创建自己的服务。AWS 提供不同的框架（例如 PyTorch、Keras 和 TensorFlow），以及带有定制 CPU 和 GPU 的特殊硬件来运行 ML 工作负载。我们从 Amazon SageMaker 开始讨论，然后简要提及其他服务。

Intelligence refers to our ability to ask questions and provide reasons for the answers to these questions. We call it AI when this intelligence is shown by machines. Machine learning is a branch of AI representing this intelligence based on previous data and algorithms. This book will not introduce you to ML concepts but rather will explore a few AWS services offering ML capabilities.
智能指的是我们提出问题并为这些问题的答案提供理由的能力。当这种智能由机器表现出来时，我们称之为 AI。机器学习是 AI 的一个分支，代表基于既往数据和算法的这种智能。本书不会向你介绍 ML 概念，而是探索若干提供 ML 能力的 AWS 服务。

Amazon SageMaker

The default benefit we achieve by choosing the AWS cloud is running any service without the worry of infrastructure management. Amazon SageMaker is an AWS-managed service that allows customers to prepare data and build, train, and deploy ML models quickly. SageMaker offers features to complete each of these steps and then finally deploy your models with ease, getting the best out of it with minimal effort:

选择 AWS 云所获得的默认好处是：运行任何服务都无需操心基础设施管理。Amazon SageMaker 是一项 AWS 托管服务，让客户能够准备数据、并快速构建、训练和部署 ML 模型。SageMaker 提供完成每个步骤的特性，最后轻松部署你的模型，以最小的努力获得最大的收益：

Prepare data. SageMaker offers tools for initial data preparation that allow you to build on top of the data, such as Data Wrangler. Data Wrangler can be added in ML workflows in Amazon SageMaker Studio to import, prepare, transform, and identify features and analyze data.

准备数据（Prepare data）。SageMaker 提供用于初始数据准备的工具，让你可以在数据之上构建，例如 Data Wrangler。Data Wrangler 可以添加到 Amazon SageMaker Studio 中的 ML 工作流里，用于导入、准备、转换和识别特征并分析数据。

Build. Customers can use Jupyter notebooks inside SageMaker Studio to build their ML models. AWS offers its own custom-built algorithms that run efficiently on the AWS infrastructure as well as on popular open source frameworks, such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. You can also write custom code if the available solutions don’t fit your use case.

构建（Build）。客户可以在 SageMaker Studio 内使用 Jupyter notebook 构建 ML 模型。AWS 提供自己定制的算法，可在 AWS 基础设施上高效运行，也支持 TensorFlow 和 PyTorch 等流行开源框架。如果可用方案不适合你的用例，你也可以编写自定义代码。

Train. As SageMaker manages all the infrastructure, you don’t have to worry about training. You can use the managed infrastructure from storage to compute.

训练（Train）。由于 SageMaker 管理所有基础设施，你无需操心训练。你可以使用从存储到计算的托管基础设施。

Page 366

Deploy. Deployment of ML models is also taken care of by SageMaker. There are multiple ways to deploy a model, and a particular method can be selected based on the use case. We recommend using real-time inference for workloads with low latency requirements, serverless inference as a fully managed solution and for workloads that can tolerate cold-start problems, asynchronous inference for workloads with large payload sizes (up to 1 GB) and near real-time processing requirements, and batch transforms for processing entire datasets.

部署（Deploy）。ML 模型的部署也由 SageMaker 负责。部署模型有多种方式，可以根据用例选择特定方法。我们推荐：对低延迟要求的工作负载使用实时推理；把 serverless 推理作为全托管方案、用于可容忍冷启动问题的工作负载；对负载较大（最大 1 GB）且有近实时处理需求的工作负载使用异步推理；对整个数据集的处理使用 batch transform。

SageMaker also offers support for A/B testing by enabling multiple ML models behind a single endpoint. A/B testing helps with figuring out how different models are performing and if they are working per expectations.

SageMaker 还通过在单个 endpoint 后端启用多个 ML 模型来支持 A/B 测试。A/B 测试帮助弄清不同模型的表现如何，以及它们是否按预期工作。

Depending on your use case, you can decide to use SageMaker for some or all these features when building and deploying your entire pipeline. For example, you can deploy on SageMaker a model that has already been trained on on-premises infrastructure.

根据你的用例，在构建和部署整条 pipeline 时，你可以决定把 SageMaker 用于其中部分或全部特性。例如，你可以把一个已经在本地基础设施上训练好的模型部署到 SageMaker 上。

SageMaker also offers the following key features:

SageMaker 还提供以下关键特性：

Clarify. SageMaker includes multiple features that can help improve your ML models, such as SageMaker Clarify. As the name dictates, it detects any potential bias and helps clarify the predictions that the ML models make using a feature-attribution approach.

Clarify。SageMaker 包含多个有助于改进 ML 模型的特性，例如 SageMaker Clarify。顾名思义，它检测任何潜在偏差，并使用特征归因方法帮助阐明 ML 模型所做的预测。

Debugger. Metrics are an important tool for visualizing performance. To visualize an ML model’s performance, you can use SageMaker Debugger. It also can identify system bottlenecks for EC2 instance jobs with metrics like CPU, GPU, GPU memory, network, and data I/O.

Debugger。指标是可视化性能的重要工具。要可视化 ML 模型的性能，你可以使用 SageMaker Debugger。它还能通过 CPU、GPU、GPU 显存、网络和数据 I/O 等指标识别 EC2 实例作业的系统瓶颈。

Pipelines. We mentioned that SageMaker helps with the entire cycle, from data preparation to model deployments. As you scale your systems, it’s very important that SageMaker is automatically managed to reduce operational overhead. SageMaker Pipelines helps with this automation and with building end-to-end CI/CD pipelines.

Pipelines。我们提到 SageMaker 助力从数据准备到模型部署的整个周期。随着系统扩缩，自动管理 SageMaker 以降低运维开销非常重要。SageMaker Pipelines 帮助实现这种自动化，并构建端到端 CI/CD 流水线。

Automatic model tuning (AMT). The ML model performance can vary based on hyperparameter values. SageMaker AMT runs the training job multiple times and figures out the best version of the model.

自动模型调优（AMT）。ML 模型性能会因超参数值而异。SageMaker AMT 多次运行训练作业，找出模型的最佳版本。

Page 367

Ground Truth. It’s important to train ML models on good-quality datasets to get the most out of them. SageMaker Ground Truth helps automate this process by creating high-quality, labeled datasets. For data-labeling tasks, you can choose the workforce, such as independent contractors, your own private workforce, or vendor companies on AWS Marketplace.

Ground Truth。要让 ML 模型发挥最大价值，在高质量数据集上训练很重要。SageMaker Ground Truth 通过创建高质量的标注数据集来自动化这一过程。对于数据标注任务，你可以选择劳动力，例如独立承包商、你自己的私有劳动力，或 AWS Marketplace 上的供应商公司。

SageMaker is a great tool for building ML solutions on the AWS cloud. Visit the SageMaker documentation for an even deeper dive into its capabilities as we couldn’t possibly fit everything into this chapter.

SageMaker 是在 AWS 云上构建 ML 方案的好工具。请访问 SageMaker 文档更深入地了解其能力，因为我们不可能把所有内容都放进本章。

There may be use cases where you don’t have the expertise to build your own solutions. In these scenarios, you can leverage different services offered by AWS to solve specific use cases.

可能有这样的用例：你没有构建自己方案的专业知识。在这些场景中，你可以利用 AWS 提供的不同服务来解决特定用例。

AWS ML Application Services

Building ML solutions on your own takes time as well as expertise in a field where you might not want to invest. If you have a general use case for ML, you can use fully managed services by AWS without the worry of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models. Some of these services include:

自行构建 ML 方案既需要时间，也需要某个领域的专业知识，而你可能并不想在该领域投入。如果你有一个通用 ML 用例，可以使用 AWS 的全托管服务，而无需操心构建、部署和维护 ML 模型。这些服务包括：

Amazon CodeWhisperer. You might be familiar with the concept of pair programming, where two people have a discussion and then code together. Amazon CodeWhisperer is your coding companion and helps you by generating code suggestions ranging from small code snippets to entire functions. It can also flag security issues in code, and it offers suggestions to remediate the raised concerns that can be easily integrated in your favorite code editor.

Amazon CodeWhisperer。你可能熟悉结对编程的概念：两个人讨论后一起写代码。Amazon CodeWhisperer 是你的编程伙伴，通过生成从小代码片段到整个函数的代码建议来帮助你。它还能标记代码中的安全问题，并提供修复所提问题的建议，可以轻松集成到你喜欢的代码编辑器中。

Amazon Comprehend. Amazon Comprehend helps with gathering insights from a document or collection of documents. In our example of an online food-ordering application, customers write reviews about food they ordered. We can use Comprehend to decipher review behavior (positive/negative) or identify which food items are being talked about. Comprehend can identify insights such as entities (person names, places, items, etc.), PII, document languages, sentiment (positive, negative, neutral, or mixed), and more.

Amazon Comprehend。Amazon Comprehend 帮助从单个文档或文档集合中提炼洞见。在我们在线点餐应用的例子中，顾客会为他们点的食物写评论。我们可以使用 Comprehend 解读评论倾向（正面/负面），或识别正在谈论哪些菜品。Comprehend 可以识别诸如实体（人名、地名、物品等）、PII、文档语言、情感（正面、负面、中性或混合）等洞见。

Amazon Kendra. Amazon Kendra is an ML-powered search engine on top of structured or unstructured data repositories. It uses natural language processing to determine which document is most relevant to a user’s search queries. You use Kendra along with Amazon Lex to build AI chatbots for use cases like customer support to resolve user queries on our online food-ordering application.

Amazon Kendra。Amazon Kendra 是一个基于 ML 的搜索引擎，构建在结构化或非结构化数据仓库之上。它使用自然语言处理来判断哪个文档与用户搜索查询最相关。你把 Kendra 与 Amazon Lex 一起使用，构建 AI 聊天机器人，用于客户支持之类的用例，以解决我们在线点餐应用上的用户查询。

Page 368

Amazon Forecast. Amazon Forecast is helpful for accurate time-series forecasts. Consider an example of an online business: how do you predict traffic for an upcoming sale based on historical traffic or what growth looks like if you launch in a new region? Forecast automatically figures out combinations of ML algorithms suitable for your dataset and helps you with the forecasts.

Amazon Forecast。Amazon Forecast 有助于准确的时间序列预测。考虑一个在线业务的例子：你如何基于历史流量预测即将到来促销的流量？或者如果在新区域上线，增长会是什么样？Forecast 自动找出适合你数据集的 ML 算法组合，并帮助你做预测。

Amazon Rekognition. Amazon Rekognition is a recognition service for image and video analysis. This service can power use cases like search over image and video content, face identification and verification, adult content detection, and text extraction from images.

Amazon Rekognition。Amazon Rekognition 是一项用于图像和视频分析的识别服务。这项服务可以支持诸如图像和视频内容搜索、人脸识别与验证、成人内容检测和图像文本提取等用例。

Amazon Transcribe. Amazon Transcribe is a speech-to-text conversion service. In our online food-ordering application example, we might offer a service where customers can submit their feedback via telephone for food items they ordered. Transcribe can help derive valuable insights from such calls. Some other use cases where it can help is converting voice input to text for processing in your systems, converting audio and video content to be searchable by text, and creating subtitles for videos.

Amazon Transcribe。Amazon Transcribe 是一项语音转文本转换服务。在我们在线点餐应用的例子中，我们可能提供这样一项服务：顾客可以通过电话为他们点的食物提交反馈。Transcribe 可以帮助从这类通话中提炼有价值的洞见。它还能在其他用例中提供帮助：把语音输入转换为文本以供系统处理、把音视频内容转换为可按文本搜索、以及为视频创建字幕。

These customized offerings provide direct integrations within our applications with minimal effort. As an example, assume that you own a blog-hosting service where users can manage their blogs and share content with their followers. To add text-to-audio functionality, you can either build your own solution or use Amazon Polly for a much faster start. As we’ve mentioned before, you can always improve on the solutions if your use case changes later or you see any bottlenecks in existing solutions. The key point is time to market: if you start with a custom solution, it might take much more time to launch the service compared to direct integration with a service like Polly.

这些定制服务以最小的努力在我们的应用内提供直接集成。举个例子，假设你拥有一个博客托管服务，用户可以管理自己的博客并与粉丝分享内容。要添加文本转音频功能，你可以自己构建方案，也可以使用 Amazon Polly 以快得多的速度起步。如前所述，如果之后你的用例变化、或你看到现有方案中的任何瓶颈，你总可以改进这些方案。关键在于上市时间：如果你从自定义方案起步，相比直接集成 Polly 这样的服务，上线服务可能要花多得多的时间。

In the next section, we’ll discuss special infrastructure support provided by AWS to build ML workloads.

下一节我们将讨论 AWS 提供的、用于构建 ML 工作负载的特殊基础设施支持。

AWS ML Infrastructure

AWS offers EC2 instances that are specialized to handle ML workloads for both training and inference. These instances include hardware-based accelerators, also referred to as coprocessors, to enhance the computing power and perform tasks like graphics processing, floating point number calculations, and data pattern matching in a much more efficient manner compared to software running on general-purpose CPUs. Some examples of accelerators include GPUs, field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), AWS Inferentia, and AWS Trainium. Let’s talk about the custom solutions offered by AWS to accelerate our ML workloads:

AWS 提供专门用于处理训练和推理 ML 工作负载的 EC2 实例。这些实例包含基于硬件的加速器（也称为协处理器），以增强计算力，比运行在通用 CPU 上的软件更高效地执行图形处理、浮点数计算和数据模式匹配等任务。加速器的一些例子包括 GPU、现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）、AWS Inferentia 和 AWS Trainium。下面我们谈谈 AWS 提供的、用于加速 ML 工作负载的定制方案：

Page 369

AWS Trainium. The Amazon EC2 Trainium instances offer up to 50% cost-to-train savings over comparable EC2 instances. These instances are optimized to run deep learning training workloads with native support of different data types, such as FP32, TF32, BF16, FP16, UINT8, and configurable FP8. It supports AWS Neuron SDK, which is natively integrated with PyTorch and TensorFlow, so existing framework applications can be used with minimal code changes.

AWS Trainium。Amazon EC2 Trainium 实例相比同类 EC2 实例最高可节省 50% 的训练成本。这些实例经过优化以运行深度学习训练工作负载，原生支持 FP32、TF32、BF16、FP16、UINT8 和可配置 FP8 等不同数据类型。它支持 AWS Neuron SDK，该 SDK 与 PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 原生集成，因此既有框架应用只需极少代码改动即可使用。

AWS Inferentia. The Amazon EC2 Inferentia instances are designed to run ML inference applications with high throughput and low latency while saving costs when compared to general-purpose EC2 instances. These types of instances offer high-speed connectivity between the accelerators, enabling deployment of billions of parameters across multiple accelerators on Inferentia EC2 instances.

AWS Inferentia。Amazon EC2 Inferentia 实例旨在以高吞吐、低延迟运行 ML 推理应用，同时相比通用 EC2 实例节省成本。这类实例在加速器之间提供高速连接，从而能够在 Inferentia EC2 实例上跨多个加速器部署数十亿参数。

Inference means reaching a conclusion based on logical reasoning and evidence, so ML inference essentially means running ML models on live data to get a final answer (or make a prediction). The training is a prephase to inference, where we train ML applications to learn from existing data and then use this intelligence at the time of inference.
推理（inference）指基于逻辑推理和证据得出结论，因此 ML 推理本质上就是在实时数据上运行 ML 模型以得到最终答案（或做出预测）。训练是推理的前置阶段，我们在其中训练 ML 应用从既有数据中学习，然后在推理时运用这种智能。

The EC2 instances are purpose built to optimize compute-heavy tasks like running large-scale models, natural language processing, speech recognition, and computer vision. You might consider the cost here: if the accelerator in these EC2 instances makes processing so fast, then it would definitely be costly, and you should decide if you can afford such an expenditure. As these instances are specifically designed for ML workloads, they are cost-effective if you compare them to EC2 instances with similar capabilities. For example, Amazon EC2 Inf1 instances provide 2.3 times higher throughput and up to 70% lower cost per inference than comparable EC2 instances. The EC2 Inf2 instances are cheaper than Inf1, with four times higher throughput and 10 times lower latency. A very good benefit of using the AWS cloud is that AWS innovates on the behalf of customers. We as customers might have been happy with the performance and cost benefits of Amazon EC2 Inf1 instances, but AWS has now launched a new version with improvements to the existing options.

这些 EC2 实例是为优化计算密集型任务而专门构建的，例如运行大规模模型、自然语言处理、语音识别和计算机视觉。这里你可能会考虑成本：如果这些 EC2 实例中的加速器让处理如此之快，那它肯定很贵，你应当判断是否负担得起这样的开销。由于这些实例专为 ML 工作负载设计，与具有类似能力的 EC2 实例相比，它们是划算的。例如，Amazon EC2 Inf1 实例相比同类 EC2 实例提供 2.3 倍的吞吐，每次推理成本最高低 70%。EC2 Inf2 实例比 Inf1 更便宜，吞吐高 4 倍、延迟低 10 倍。使用 AWS 云的一个很大好处是 AWS 代表客户做创新。作为客户的我们可能已经对 Amazon EC2 Inf1 实例的性能和成本收益感到满意，但 AWS 现在又推出了对既有选项加以改进的新版本。

Conclusion

This chapter introduced you to AWS services that are helpful when building and running big data analytics and ML workloads at any scale. You may often want to use a combination of multiple services to serve your use case best, such as Amazon EMR to process the live streaming data published to Amazon MSK or plotting Amazon Redshift data via Amazon QuickSight. Since AWS provides easy integration with all

its services, it is a seamless experience to use any service and fit it into other service components to meet your requirements.

服务的轻松集成，使用任意服务并把它嵌入其他服务组件来满足你的需求是一种无缝体验。

In the second part of this chapter, we looked into AWS ML offerings, which essentially run ML workloads with zero or minimal operational overhead. AWS offers multiple services to solve specific use cases, which help us utilize the capabilities of ML without having vast knowledge of the concepts. For example, imagine building a language translation tool on your own versus using Amazon Translate. Amazon Translate will reduce the time to market of launching your application with translation capability.

在本章第二部分，我们考察了 AWS ML 服务，它们本质上以零或最小运维开销运行 ML 工作负载。AWS 提供多项服务解决特定用例，帮助我们在不具备深厚概念知识的情况下利用 ML 的能力。例如，想象一下自己构建一个语言翻译工具，与使用 Amazon Translate 相比。Amazon Translate 会缩短你推出带翻译能力应用的上市时间。

We concluded with several infrastructure options that are specialized to run ML workloads at scale with higher throughput and lower cost when compared to general-purpose comparable hardware.

我们最后介绍了若干基础设施选项，它们专门用于大规模运行 ML 工作负载，相比同类通用硬件具有更高吞吐和更低成本。
